entries.title: 3F Arrillaga Student Center
entries.text: The Commons and Takaki Terrace will be closed all day today, Wed, 11/18 for a multiple school conference. Pds 1-5 study halls will be in Seto. Thank you.

entries.title: Special Teahouse Activity
entries.text: Please join us tomorrow, Thu 11/19 in the Teahouse for a special activity from 10:15am-1:00pm. We look forward to being present, creating and connecting with you. SRS: Show your appreciation. Grab thank you cards from CCO or SAO office. Please write and hand-deliver a personal note to your teachers writing your recommendation letters, to thank them for their time and support.

entries.title: Winter Ball
entries.text: The Winter Ball Committee will be hosting an info mtg this morning. After the Daily Bulletin is read, all students in grades 9-12 should head to the Lower Gym. During the meeting, you’ll learn about the registration and payment process for Winter Ball, along with the dress code, key logistics, and other important details.

entries.title: Food4thought
entries.text: A NEW OPPORTUNITY FOR RESCUE: Honolulu’s G.R.O.W. program lets households put food scraps into their green bins, turning leftovers and peels into compost. Help your family participate correctly: keep edible food for eating first, then put accepted scraps in, loose, without any packaging or bags. Watch the 1:23 HNN news story HERE

entries.title: Food4thought
entries.text: ALOHA HARVEST: Way too often, edible, nutritious food cannot reach those who need it. Aloha Harvest plays a critical role in this food rescue and distribution! Watch this video (1:43) about what they do for our food cycle. How might you get involved with Aloha Harvest? You can meet their CEO before school at the chapel on Friday this week. Contact Ms. Sakuda in the C+CE Office with any questions.

entries.title: --[With the Correct Link From Last Week] Food4thought
entries.text: CO-OPS: Despite the many obstacles that can make it hard for healthy food to reach our plates, there are strategies that support production, processing, and distribution to consumers! Please watch this 3-minute video and learn how valuable co-ops can be! How can YOU support co-ops like this one?

entries.title: Filmmaking Club
entries.text: Interested in watching or making films? Come to mtg, today, Wed, 11/18, Sullivan 3F, outside the Seminar Room. Bring lunch and a friend, and come to watch, talk, and learn more about filmmaking. No experience required!

entries.title: Gender-sexuality Alliance
entries.text: Join us this Fri, 11/20, lunch, W-311. We will gather in honor of Transgender Day of Remembrance. Bring your lunch and a friend. Everyone is welcome!

entries.title: Okinawan Club
entries.text: Hai Sai - Hai Tai! Please join us tomorrow, Thurs, 11/19, lunch, W215 for our second official Okinawan Club Meeting of this school year. Bring $10 dues and join us for andagi, snacks, Okinawan culture and fun! Dues need to be paid for our yummy club lunches and to be on the OFFICIAL ROSTER.
